scenes.description: A close-up of a runner tying their shoes on a city sidewalk at dawn
Wide shot of the runner sprinting through an empty urban street
Montage of the runner passing landmarks with upbeat music
The runner stops at a hilltop overlooking the city, product reveal
Brand tagline and CTA appear with energetic music crescendo

hook: Opens with an intimate close-up of running shoes being laced up, creating curiosity about the runner's journey ahead
transcript: Every morning starts with a choice. You can stay comfortable, or you can push beyond what you thought possible. FuelMax gives you the energy to go further. Push your limits.
